section.heading: Passive activity losses and credits limited

subsection.heading: Dispositions of entire interest in passive activity
subsection.chapeau: If during the taxable year a taxpayer disposes of his entire interest in any passive activity (or former passive activity), the following rules shall apply:

subparagraph.heading: In general
subparagraph.chapeau: If all gain or loss realized on such disposition is recognized, the excess of—

clause.content: any loss from such activity for such taxable year (determined after the application of subsection (b)), over
any net income or gain for such taxable year from all other passive activities (determined after the application of subsection (b)),

subparagraph.continuation: shall be treated as a loss which is not from a passive activity.

subparagraph.heading: Subparagraph (A) not to apply to disposition involving related party

content.p: If the taxpayer and the person acquiring the interest bear a relationship to each other described in section 267(b) or section 707(b)(1), then subparagraph (A) shall not apply to any loss of the taxpayer until the taxable year in which such interest is acquired (in a transaction described in subparagraph (A)) by another person who does not bear such a relationship to the tax­payer.

To the extent provided in regulations, income or gain from the activity for preceding taxable years shall be taken into account under subparagraph (A)(ii) for the taxable year to the extent necessary to prevent the avoidance of this section.

paragraph.heading: Disposition by death
paragraph.chapeau: If an interest in the activity is transferred by reason of the death of the taxpayer—

subparagraph.chapeau: paragraph (1)(A) shall apply to losses described in paragraph (1)(A) to the extent such losses are greater than the excess (if any) of—

clause.content: the basis of such property in the hands of the transferee, over
the adjusted basis of such property immediately before the death of the taxpayer, and

subparagraph.content: any losses to the extent of the excess described in subparagraph (A) shall not be allowed as a deduction for any taxable year.

content.p: In the case of an installment sale of an entire interest in an activity to which section 453 applies, paragraph (1) shall apply to the portion of such losses for each taxable year which bears the same ratio to all such losses as the gain recognized on such sale during such taxable year bears to the gross profit from such sale (realized or to be realized when payment is completed).

note.heading: Amendments
note.p: 2021—Subsec. (i)(3)(E)(ii). Pub. L. 117–2 substituted “85(c), 135, and 137” for “135 and 137”.
